hot.l: FOR THIS MOMENT Adhkaar on waking The first words of the day

REMINDER FOR TODAY 15 RABIʿ AL-THANI 1448 Abu Hurairah said: My beloved friend ﷺ advised me to do three things: fast three days of every month, pray two units of the forenoon prayer, and pray witr before I sleep. SAHIH AL-BUKHARI 1981; SAHIH MUSLIM 721

Waking in the night لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr. Subḥānallāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wallāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh. Rabbighfir lī. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah. My Lord, forgive me. Whoever wakes at night and says this, then asks forgiveness, is forgiven; and if he prays, his prayer is accepted. al-Bukhari 1154
